launcherSettings.title: Launcher settings
launcherSettings.name.description: Display name in tray icon tooltip
launcherSettings.type.title: Type
launcherSettings.webAddress.title: Web address
launcherSettings.icon.webDescription: Taken from the page automatically, or pick one here
launcherSettings.icon.selectionFailed: Could not change the icon. Choose a readable image file and try again.
launcherSettings.customIcon.title: Custom icon
launcherSettings.showInTray.title: Show in tray
launcherSettings.showInTray.description: Show this launcher's icon in the system tray
launcherSettings.viewMode.title: View mode
launcherSettings.viewMode.description: How items appear in the flyout popup
launcherSettings.iconsPerRow.title: Icons per row
launcherSettings.iconsPerRow.description: How many icons fit across each icon-mode column
launcherSettings.showTitle.title: Show title
launcherSettings.showTitle.description: Show the launcher name at the top of the flyout
launcherSettings.tabBar.title: Tab bar
launcherSettings.tabBar.description: Keep the tab strip on screen with one page open. Off, it appears as soon as there is a second
launcherSettings.addressBar.title: Address bar
launcherSettings.addressBar.description: Show the page address under the header, with a star for bookmarking it
launcherSettings.bookmarksBar.title: Bookmarks bar
launcherSettings.bookmarksBar.descriptio: Shows this launcher's bookmarks along the bottom of the flyout, where they are added, renamed, put into folders and reordered.
launcherSettings.bookmarkIconsOnly.title: Bookmark icons only
launcherSettings.bookmarkIconsOnly.descr: Hides every bookmark's label, leaving just its icon.
launcherSettings.flyoutSize.title: Flyout size
launcherSettings.flyoutSize.description: Width × height of the web flyout, in pixels
launcherSettings.zoom.title: Zoom
launcherSettings.zoom.description: Page zoom inside the flyout, also on the flyout's “…” menu
launcherSettings.opensAt.title: Opens at
launcherSettings.opensAt.anchoredDescrip: Where it opens on the screen holding its tray icon. A move lasts until you close it
launcherSettings.opensAt.lastPositionDes: Drag the flyout anywhere and it opens there next time
launcherSettings.rememberSize.title: Remember size changes
launcherSettings.rememberSize.descriptio: Keep this flyout at the size you drag it to; otherwise it reopens at the size above
launcherSettings.regularWindow.title: Regular window
launcherSettings.regularWindow.descripti: Behave like an ordinary app window: taskbar button, Alt-Tab entry, not always on top, and stays open until closed
launcherSettings.closeOnFocusLoss.title: Close on focus loss
launcherSettings.closeOnFocusLoss.descri: Dismiss like a flyout when you click elsewhere, while keeping the taskbar button and Alt-Tab entry
launcherSettings.taskbarClick.title: Taskbar click
launcherSettings.taskbarClick.descriptio: What clicking this launcher's taskbar button does while it is open
launcherSettings.pinOpen.title: Pin open
launcherSettings.pinOpen.description: Stay on screen when you click elsewhere, instead of dismissing like a flyout
launcherSettings.openLinksInBrowser.desc: Hand a link that opens a new window to your default browser, instead of opening it in a tab here
launcherSettings.reloadOnOpen.title: Reload on open
launcherSettings.reloadOnOpen.descriptio: Fetch the page again each time, instead of showing it as you left it
launcherSettings.hiddenPolicy.title: When hidden
launcherSettings.hiddenPolicy.descriptio: Unloading frees all memory and stops video and polling; staying loaded reopens instantly
launcherSettings.unloadAfter.title: Unload after
launcherSettings.unloadAfter.description: Minutes the flyout may sit closed before the page is dropped
launcherSettings.fullscreenFillsLauncher: Keep page fullscreen inside the launcher window
launcherSettings.fitFullscreenToVideo.de: Fit the launcher to the video while fullscreen fills the launcher
launcherSettings.signIns.title: Sign-ins
launcherSettings.signIns.description: Pooled with every launcher set to share, so one sign-in covers them all. Private keeps this launcher's cookies to itself; for a second account on a site another launcher already uses
launcherSettings.saveLogins.title: Save logins
launcherSettings.saveLogins.sharedDescri: Offer to save logins and fill them in, for every launcher on the shared profile. Turn off when a password manager extension is doing it, so the two do not compete
launcherSettings.saveLogins.privateDescr: Offer to save logins and fill them in. Turn off when a password manager extension is doing it, so the two do not compete
launcherSettings.savedLogins.title: Saved logins
launcherSettings.savedLogins.description: Forget every login and form entry saved for this profile. Logins kept by a password manager extension are not affected
launcherSettings.savedLogins.notRunning: Open this launcher first; its saved logins can only be cleared while its browser is running.
launcherSettings.sitePermissions.title: Site permissions
launcherSettings.sitePermissions.descrip: Forget what you have allowed and blocked, so this launcher's pages ask again
launcherSettings.sitePermissions.profile: Forget what you have allowed and blocked, so this profile’s pages ask again
launcherSettings.sitePermissions.cleared: Cleared. This launcher's pages will ask again.
launcherSettings.sitePermissions.pending: Will be cleared the next time this launcher opens.
launcherSettings.browsingData.title: Browsing data
launcherSettings.browsingData.sharedDesc: Signs out of the shared profile; every launcher using it
launcherSettings.browsingData.privateDes: Signs out of the page and clears its cookies and cache
launcherSettings.browsingData.clearFaile: Could not clear this launcher's browsing data. Close its panel and try again.
launcherSettings.opensAt.screenDescripti: Where it opens on the screen holding its tray icon
launcherSettings.opensAt.preserved: Saved position (preserved; not supported here yet)
launcherSettings.pinOpen.regularWindowHi: Use the KDE window menu to keep a regular Wayland window above others.
launcherSettings.browsingData.descriptio: Clear cookies and site data on this machine. Shared sign-ins affect all launchers using that profile.
launcherSettings.browsingData.confirmSha: Clear cookies and site data for all launchers with shared sign-ins? This signs you out of websites on this machine.
launcherSettings.browsingData.confirmPri: Clear cookies and site data for this launcher? This signs you out of websites on this machine.
launcherSettings.profileChangePending: Finish changing sign-ins with Done before changing this profile’s data.
launcherSettings.profileChanged: This launcher’s sign-in profile changed. Reopen settings before changing its data.
